name: TaxRate
description: A configured tax rate applied at checkout.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for this rate.

state.description: State code for this rate (empty for country-wide rates).

postcode.description: Postcode or range for this rate.

rate.description: Tax rate percentage as a decimal string (e.g. 20.0000).

name.description: Tax rate label shown to customers.

priority.description: Priority of this tax rate (used when multiple rates match the same address).

compound.description: Whether this is a compound tax rate (applied on top of other taxes).

shipping.description: Whether the tax applies to shipping costs.

class.description: Tax class slug. Standard class is identified by an empty string.
